requirements.title: LOGICAL storage-size named constants select matching kinds or required negative codes
requirements.definition: LOGICAL8, LOGICAL16, LOGICAL32, and LOGICAL64 are default integer scalar constants for logical kinds with storage sizes 8, 16, 32, and 64 bits respectively, or the required negative code -2 or -1 based on larger-kind availability.

pending.LOGICAL-storage-constants-default-intege: Assign LOGICAL8, LOGICAL16, LOGICAL32, and LOGICAL64 to default integer variables initialized to -777; assert each KIND equals KIND(0) and each RANK equals 0. Mutate LOGICAL32 to REAL32.
pending.LOGICAL-storage-positive-kind-size: Use requested bit table 8,16,32,64. Generated branch-partition fixtures declare LOGICAL(KIND=constant) values for positive constants and assert STORAGE_SIZE(value) equals the requested bit count. Mutate the bit table by swapping 32 and 64.
pending.LOGICAL-storage-negative-code-branches: Generated branch-partition fixtures compare LOGICAL_KINDS storage sizes against requested bit table 8,16,32,64 and assert -2 exactly for absence with larger supported size and -1 exactly for absence without larger supported size. Mutate the -2 and -1 expected codes.
